headline: A Qwen3.5 27B model reports improving its own weights through inference-time edits
summary: A Nov 16 arXiv preprint reports that a Qwen3.5 27B model used its own reasoning and test runs to edit its weights without gradients or an optimizer. In one protocol, two of three submitted edits improved held-out math accuracy by 6.6 and 4.0 percentage points; a separate edit improved a prespecified held-out test by 1.1 points. A model also repaired a deliberately corrupted copy of its weights. The tests cover one model family and do not establish general or continuing self-improvement.
